page.layout: One printed page, title page: centred title lines in capitals, followed by an engraved vignette (tree with banner, not transcribed), then the imprint lines centred below. Library stamps (Napoli oval stamp, round seal) and a handwritten "2" at top right are not printed text and are left out. Digitiser banner at bottom right left out.
page.notes: Engraving: a tree with a banner reading "NON SOLUM" and a standing figure, with a snake-like scroll at left; not transcribed. The date line is printed as CIↃ IↃC LVII, i.e. MDCLVII; the reversed-C numerals are rendered here as printed in roman capitals ("clo loc lvii"), with the numeral corrected to MDCLVII in the Roman form. The stamp "BIBLIOTECA NAZIONALE VITTORIO EMANUELE III - NAPOLI" and the round seal are not transcribed.
